messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "withdrawal symptoms if stopped suddenly"
set: ["withdrawal symptoms if stopped suddenly", "withdrawal symptoms if combined with certain medicines", "symptoms especially reported when stopped abruptly", "opioids can cause sudden withdrawal symptoms", "stopping abruptly can cause serious withdrawal symptoms", "can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "may cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn", "breathing problems or withdrawal symptoms if you start or stop taking certain other medicines", "prolonged use during pregnancy can cause withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "not to stop it suddenly", "adverse reactions likely when stopped abruptly", "use for extended period during pregnancy can cause life-threatening withdrawal symptoms in newborn baby", "stopping suddenly can trigger thyroid crisis", "most settle after the medicine is stopped", "stopping suddenly may cause chest pain or heart attack", "symptoms usually not serious"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
